profile.headline: Software Engineer | MS Computer Science - Georgia Tech | .NET | Python | Data & Visualization

positions.title: Management Trainee (Software Development)
positions.description:
- Led development of a Python/JavaScript-based data visualization web app using Flask, Plotly, and Bootstrap
- Built CI/CD pipelines and transitioned a local app to production with Azure DevOps and JFrog Artifactory
- Developed predictive models to forecast locomotive failures using Python, SQL, and ML techniques on 500M+ records
- Optimized .NET apps for real-time locomotive log retrieval and visualization
positions.insights: Skills: Bootstrap (Framework) · MongoDB · Plotly · SQL Server Management Studio · C# · Data Modeling · NetworkX · Python (Programming Language) · WinForms · JavaScript · SQL · .NET Framework

positions.title: Intern (Software Development)
positions.description:
- Built Python/Tkinter applications to automate locomotive log parsing from network drives
- Created interactive Tableau dashboards for engineering teams to explore locomotive trends
positions.insights: Skills: Algorithms · Tableau · NetworkX · Python (Programming Language) · Program Development · Splunk · SQL
